source_title: AMMB STIG Seminar, 2 Nov 2026 - NASA Science (.gov)
source_excerpt:
2 November 2026 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET
NASA HQ has asked AMMB STIG where our community can strengthen or add to SMD's inputs to the M2M architecture technology gaps. The ask is existing technology, flown or in development, that represents or advances the state of the art for a gap. It is not about new missions.
Connection information will be updated in advance of the meeting.
